_what_this_is: The three-room liner proof: a WRITING ROOM (1 box), a LONG GALLERY (2 boxes long, cells `gallery` + `gallery_far`) and a GRAND SALOON (2 by 2 boxes, cells `saloon` `saloon_e` `saloon_n` `saloon_ne`), all one deck, inboard, windowless. Every cell of a many-box room shares its room's name and is joined to its neighbours by full-width open edges a visitor walks with the up arrow. Nothing in these four files is in the engine; a location is data.
name: liner-3
title: SS MERIDIAN 1934
